description: What the installed extensions ADD to the apps — the answer to "where did this new menu item come from", "what is this extra block on the product page", "what did installing X actually change". Every entry belongs to an installed extension; nothing here is part of the base product. Read `platform` to know where it shows up: `hub` = this admin cabinet, `builder` = the POS flow builder, `render` = the station screen. Within `hub`, type `merchant-hub-page` is a navigation entry of its own and `merchant-hub-widget` is a block embedded in a detail page — `attachedTo` says which one (products / orders / customers / users). LIMITATION: this tells you which extension-provided screens EXIST, not what they contain — each one is an embedded page owned by its extension, and this agent cannot open or read it. It also cannot say which extension contributed a given entry. To go the other way — what is installed at all — use get_installed_extensions.
name: hub_get_extension_surfaces
title: List extension screens
